description.blurb: Nix is the inner of the two moons discovered orbiting Pluto in 2005 by the Hubble Space Telescope.
description.more: Nix and Hydra are roughly 5,000 times fainter than Pluto and are about two to three times farther from Pluto than its large moon, Charon, which was discovered in 1978. Nix and Hydra are roughly 20 to 70 miles (32 to 113 km) wide.They are so small and so faint that scientists combined a short exposure of Pluto and Charon and a long exposure of Nix and Hydra to create images of them all together. Nix was named for the Greek goddess of darkness and night and mother of Charon.
